items.text: please confirm transaction id

items.context: Would you like to receive an update on the refund status?
items.text: send me status update

items.context: Is the refund status showing as pending on your app?
items.text: yes refund pending
mera paisa to cut gaya par transfer nahi hua
maine kal payment ki thi lekin amount apne account mein wapas nahi aaya
upi transaction failed tha lekin amount to mere account se deduct ho gaya
refund kab milega kyunki payment nahi hua hai
paise kat gaye hain par receiver ne koi amount receive nahi kiya
main same issue ka samna kar raha hun mera paise kat chuka hai
please jaldi se mere deducted amount ko refund kar dijiye

items.context: Can you please provide the transaction ID?
items.text: haan confirm karta hun transaction id 12345 hai

items.context: Is the refund status showing as pending on your app?
items.text: nahi refund status abhi show nahi kar raha hai

items.context: Would you like to receive an update on the refund status?
items.text: please mere transaction ka status batao

items.context: Have you checked your account statement for the refund?
items.text: maine apne account statement mein nahi dekha refund

items.context: Did the transaction show failure after deducting money?
items.text: paise deduct hone ke baad payment failed aa gaya tha
maine bank app se transfer kiya tha lekin payment failed hone ke baad bhi mera paisa cut gaya ab refund chahiye mujhe jaldi
kal ki transaction hai jisme paisa ja nahi paya par meri account se paisa definitely kat gaya hai isiliye mujhe refund process karna hai
mainne ek online payment kiya tha par transaction fail ho gaya lekin paisa toh mera account se deduct ho chuka hai
umid hai ki aap meri madad karenge kyunki mera paise kat gaya hai par transaction failed ho gaya tha
payment gateway par problem ke karan mera transaction complete nahi hua lekin mere account se amount deducted dikh raha hai
kya aap help karenge ji kyunki mere transaction mein paise kat gaye hain par mera payment receiver ko nahi gaya
mai is baat se pareshaan hu ki mere account se paise to kat chuke hain par meri failed transaction ke wajah se refund nahi hua abhi tak

items.context: Please provide transaction ID for verification.
items.text: maine transaction ID share kar diya hai aap please confirm karo paisa return hone ka process start karna hai mujhe

items.context: Is your refund already reflected in the app?
items.text: aapne pucha hai kya refund pending hai to haan mera refund abhi tak reflect nahi hua hai app mein

items.context: When would you like the refund to be processed?
items.text: jab aapne pucha transfer kab karna chahoge to mera kehna hai jaldi se jaldi paisa wapas aajaaye kyunki kaam ke liye zarurat hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: failed_upi_refund - a UPI or online payment failed but money was debited; wants a refund
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
